title: Dissent escalation (v0.2: paraphrased signal)
description: Use the swarm's honest members as tripwires: always escalate an episode where code shipped over a reviewer's objection, on top of a code-only trusted score. Redundant review (k=3) gives an honest witness a chance to object, so this should raise the catch rate where colluders hold only a majority, at almost no cost. v0.2 rerun with the same method and prediction against a red team that rewords its covert signal every time.
